falsifiers.claim: the P2-B cold-recovery gate does not independently recover the verifier's trusted source basis
falsifiers.observation: Process A writes its own `sourceBasis` into handoff.json and Process B uses `trustedBasis: handoff.sourceBasis`; the experiment establishes VALUE MATCHING, not independent recovery of the verifier's trusted configuration
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the read side must obtain its authority from a trusted product composition boundary, not from the producer's own handoff

falsifiers.claim: computeTrustedSourceBasis hashes executable PATH STRINGS, not executable contents or a trusted manifest
falsifiers.observation: the digest input is the path string (`createHash('sha256').update(value,'utf8')`); no content read exists in the module
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: path matching must be distinguished from producer authenticity

falsifiers.claim: a CONTROLLED_STUB record with a matching basis can still return ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED
falsifiers.observation: a recorder with sourceKind=CONTROLLED_STUB and the verifier's exact basis produces a record the qualifier returns ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED for; the qualifier never reads sourceKind
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a controlled stub must not become first-party-verified merely because the path-based basis matches

falsifiers.claim: a finalization recorded BEFORE the observation is accepted
falsifiers.observation: seq 1 CLOSED finalization (candidateCount 0) followed by seq 2 observation still yields ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED; no ordering check exists
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: no accepted observation may predate an improperly early finalization

falsifiers.claim: a finalization whose observedCandidateCount disagrees with the actual candidate set is not detected
falsifiers.observation: a finalization claiming 99 candidates for an invocation that observed 1 still yields ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the observation count must match the finalized candidate set

falsifiers.claim: the delegation collapses distinct child-lifecycle facts into one close reason
falsifiers.observation: the port emits DIRECT_CHILD_EXIT_OBSERVED / TIMEOUT_REQUESTED / ABORT_REQUESTED / EXIT_UNCONFIRMED separately, but the delegation records the single closeReason INVOCATION_RETURNED
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: finalization must be grounded in the actual closure observation, distinguishing timeout from close

falsifiers.claim: the qualifier can return a stale qualified association when a conflict is appended during the async Header read
falsifiers.observation: the qualifier reads the durable history once, then awaits the DSH header read, then returns without rechecking the store; there is no currentness protocol
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a detected relevant race must not return an unconditional stale ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED

falsifiers.claim: Store Append does not validate eventId against the canonical identity
falsifiers.observation: appending with eventId 'xas-deliberately-wrong' is accepted and replayed verbatim
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: eventId must equal associationEventId(canonical identity) on append and replay

falsifiers.claim: Store Replay does not check the SQLite columns against the payload
falsifiers.observation: parseStoredEvent never reads row.attempt_id; the replayed event exposes only the payload's attemptId
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: row.project_id/attempt_id/type must be validated against the payload

falsifiers.claim: Work revalidation only requires a non-null Attempt record
falsifiers.observation: WorkRevalidationPort.readAttempt returns {taskId,state}|null; the qualifier never verifies the exact historical ATTEMPT_CREATED event, while the V0 admission path already does
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the exact canonical historical Attempt identity must be validated; prefer reuse of the existing V0S/H0 admission logic

falsifiers.claim: an internally inconsistent binding state can expose events
falsifiers.observation: events are gated only on `sessionReadAdmission === 'ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT' && !pageRefused`; no validator refuses SESSION_CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED + null dshSessionId + ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a small pure admission validator must prohibit contradictory combinations

falsifiers.claim: a caller-built association object can satisfy the H1 resolver
falsifiers.observation: resolveVerifiedSessionBinding accepts any object carrying observationState=PRODUCER_OBSERVED, durableBindingRef!==null and verification=VERIFIED; nothing ties the object to a durable store
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the production adapter must obtain qualifications from the durable read side, never a caller-supplied array

falsifiers.claim: normal product composition does not establish the full path
falsifiers.observation: host/dsh/lib/index.js derives a BRANCH port but never a WORK worker port; launch.ts never constructs one; install.ts composes neither the execution-association concern nor a trajectory surface
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: the ordinary supported composition must be able to produce and query real association evidence

falsifiers.claim: the preview digest can stay unchanged while the observation basis changes
falsifiers.observation: the digest covers execution events and identity but not readWatermark or knownEventCount
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: semantic-content stability must be distinguished from observation-basis stability

falsifiers.claim: the P2-B mandatory wrappers can return ordinary PASS without running
falsifiers.observation: the wrappers early-return null when DSH/dist is absent and then assert the absence rather than an explicit SKIPPED/BLOCKED outcome
falsifiers.expectedInvariant: a mandatory qualification gate must return PASS/BLOCKED/NOT_ESTABLISHED with actual execution evidence
